name: Modnetic Amber
description: Dark modular multi-FX rack for JIVE declarative markup: near-black panels, amber accents, sectioned columns (Character / Modulation / Routing / Echo / Mix), big central tape-echo module with beat-synced repeat, amber routing diagram and vertical output faders. Inspired by a Modnetic-style reference shot.

lookAndFeel.summary: Header-only JUCE 9 LookAndFeel owning the widget chrome JIVE markup cannot style: grey gradient rotary dials with pale pointer, amber value arc + end-dot, tick-dot ring on dials >= 90px, hairline sliders with amber fill (bar thumb on wide sliders, round dot elsewhere), flat dark button/combo chips, dark popup with amber highlight, amber checkbox square
lookAndFeel.pluginUsage: copy the header into the plugin, hold it as a member of the editor, setLookAndFeel(&laf) in ctor / setLookAndFeel(nullptr) in dtor
lookAndFeel.previewUsage: jive-preview layout.xml --laf modnetic [--screenshot out.png]  |  APC_JIVE_PREVIEW_ARGS="--laf modnetic" bash scripts/preview-jive.sh <Name>

preview: bash scripts/preview-jive.sh <PluginName> [v<N>] with APC_JIVE_PREVIEW_ARGS="--laf modnetic" (copy as Design/v1-layout.xml)

typography.fontFamilyHeadings: system default (JIVE inherits host font; override via style 'font-family')

components.sectionBullet: 10x10 accent square (Component, border-radius 2) before section title
components.knobLabels: sibling <Text> under each Knob (child <Text> overlays the dial on pin 89d5787)
components.icons: inline <svg> children (transport triangles, playback arrow, logo) - no unicode glyphs
components.spacing: leading/trailing flex-grow spacers + fixed gap blocks (space-evenly is uneven on nested columns)

layout.window: 1200x760, flex column: header bar + body row
layout.headerBar: brand + preset ComboBox + prev/next + A/B slots + Mix Lock checkbox + license text + svg logo
columns: col-echo flex-grow: Repeat 122px knob, 2/16 readout, Beats combo, Intensity, Playback row | Heads/Wow/Level/Hold

jiveNotes.styles: JSON only, in style='{}' attribute (background, foreground, border, border-radius, font-*, letter-spacing, text-decoration)
jiveNotes.displayRequired: every element with children needs display="flex"|"grid"|"block"
jiveNotes.comboBoxSelection: selected="<index>" on the ComboBox; Option selected="true" is ignored on pin 89d5787
jiveNotes.knobLabelPattern: sibling Text, not child (child overlays dial) - verified via headless screenshot
jiveNotes.verticalDistribution: space-evenly distributes unevenly in nested flex columns on this pin; use flex-grow spacer blocks
jiveNotes.widgetChrome: styled by the bundled ModneticLookAndFeel.h (jive-preview flag: --laf modnetic); without it, chrome falls back to the host LookAndFeel
